app_fee.value: International applicants pay $70 for any degree type, including the PhD.
app_fee.quote: The following application fees are charged for every application you submit except for sanctioned dual degree programs. | All degree types $70

fee_waiver.value: No application fee waivers for international applicants. Some departments waived the fee for domestic applicants in an October 2026 free week.
fee_waiver.quote: No, we do not grant fee waivers.

also.quote: There are no application fee waivers being offered for International Applicants.

gre_general.value: The graduate school does not require the GRE or GMAT for graduate admission; a program may still require it.
gre_general.quote: However, a graduate program may require a GRE or GMAT score | as part of its admissions criteria | not require the Graduate Record Exam (GRE) or the Graduate | Management Admission Test (GMAT) for graduate admission

toefl_min.value: The general graduate minimum is TOEFL iBT 71. Many programs set higher scores, so check each program record.
toefl_min.quote: All graduate applicants must obtain a minimum TOEFL-IBT score of 71 -or- a minimum IELTS score of 6.0

ielts_min.value: The general graduate minimum is IELTS Academic 6.0. Many programs set higher scores.
ielts_min.quote: All graduate applicants must obtain a minimum TOEFL-IBT score of 71 -or- a minimum IELTS score of 6.0

english_waiver.value: India is not on the country list for the English-test waiver, so Indian applicants need a test score unless another exception applies.
english_waiver.quote: Applicants primarily educated in the following countries/territories | All international applicants whose education has been primarily outside the United States of America must provide objective evidence of proficiency in the English language

notes: Rules from the graduate school pages. Program-level English minimums come from the graduate school table (kent.edu/admissions/graduate-program-english-requirements). The domestic Free Application Week (Oct 19-26, 2026) is closed as of the check date and is not open to internationals.
